label: British Turn-up
description: The British turn-up, or gauntlet cuff, consists of a wide folded-back band at the sleeve end — typically a separate piece of fabric — creating a prominent visible cuff that wraps the wrist like a glove gauntlet. This Edwardian detail fell out of mainstream fashion but was kept alive by Savile Row bespoke tailors and enjoyed a revival in the 1950s and 1960s, particularly on English-made suit jackets and dinner coats. It is a highly visible mark of custom craftsmanship and adds visual weight and luxury to the sleeve end.
